rationale: Reviewed all 60 registered300 Y496-555 planes and six representative X/Z contact sheets (18 displayed planes, X271 repeated). Candidates supplement the ventricular rim and tapering anterior termination without filling the adjacent gray nucleus or crossing the intervening tissue into cortical sulci. The source cavity tapers to a slit near Y551 and is closed on following planes. Majority support is candidate generation, not sole anatomical identification. Existing nonzero labels are preserved.
limitation: AI image review, not expert review or complete ventricular segmentation. Selected X/Z checks, no additional native100 review. Medial crop continuation and other ventricular omissions remain unresolved. Integration verification recorded separately; not public deployment.
